title.zh: Solana to triple transaction size as apps get room for more complex trades

current_state.zh: Solana 已激活 Transaction V1，单笔交易数据容量提升三倍以上；250ms slot 时间缩减接近主网激活。
current_state.en: Solana has activated Transaction V1, tripling per-transaction data capacity; the reduction to 250ms slots is approaching mainnet activation.

updates.title_zh: Solana triples transaction size as major upgrades meet record network activity
updates.title_en: Solana triples transaction size as major upgrades meet record network activity
updates.what_changed_zh: Solana 于 9 月 15 日激活 Transaction V1，将单笔交易数据容量扩大三倍以上至 4,096 字节，并准备将 slot 时间缩短至 250ms。
updates.what_changed_en: Solana activated Transaction V1 on Sept. 15, increasing per-transaction data capacity by more than threefold to 4,096 bytes, and is preparing to cut slot times to 250ms.
updates.current_state_zh: Solana 已激活 Transaction V1，单笔交易数据容量提升三倍以上；250ms slot 时间缩减接近主网激活。
updates.current_state_en: Solana has activated Transaction V1, tripling per-transaction data capacity; the reduction to 250ms slots is approaching mainnet activation.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Solana has activated Transaction V1, tripling per-transaction data capacity and preparing to cut slot times to 250ms as the network handles record transaction volumes across stablecoins, apps, and tokenized equities.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Solana has activated Transaction V1, tripling per-transaction data capacity and preparing to cut slot times to 250ms as the network handles record transaction volumes across stablecoins, apps, and tokenized equities.
